topic: Is RouteKit's models[] fallback list worth it, or is a single model field enough?
side_a: The models[] fallback list is the point of a gateway.
side_b: A single model field is enough; fallbacks add complexity.
reason: B conceded that a 429 ends a one-shot client.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: models[] is the product. The single model field is a convenience for one-shot routing and will not retry a second vendor on 429.
claims: single model field does not retry vendors

turns.speaker: caesar
turns.text: A 2 – B 0. Latest: A. grounding=0.90. A distinguished models[] from the single model field.
claims: single model field does not retry vendors

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: One model field keeps the request simple. I concede: without models[] a 429 is the end of the line, which is why the list exists.
